Consider scheduling a comprehensive skin restoration plan that includes treatments like chemical peels or laser skin resurfacing, which can significantly improve texture and tone. Additionally, we can explore options for your lateral canthus and other areas with Botox to maintain that youthful glow. Don't forget, we have you on the books for your full Botox retreatment in a monthâ€”let's make sure your skin looks its best for your upcoming vacation!
